notes.title: New Updates
notes.content:
Greetings!
[list]
    [*]Achievements bug fixed. For previous version, players can get achievements by resolving any one level.
    [*]Smooth animation.
    [*]Add window mode.
[/list]

It's my honor to receive you feedback. Thanks for support!
